unit.why: A single narrative, transmitted by letter, of the Seer of Lublin's mysterious fall from his window on Simhat Torah after an attempt with other tzaddikim to hasten the redemption, and its aftermath.

stories.start_quote: כתב לי ידי"נ ומחו' הגאבד"ק פלונסק שליט״א
stories.end_quote: הי' עומד בבהמ"ד בשירו ושבח עכ״ל
stories.summary_en: After Napoleon's fall, the Seer of Lublin, the Maggid of Kozienice and others try to force the messianic end. On Simhat Torah night the Seer is mysteriously cast from his window and found injured; he later says Heaven judged him for pressing the end and the dead Maggid softened his fall; he dies on the following Tisha b'Av, while fire falls on R. Naftali's house.
